name: Ponce de León to Florida
traveler: Juan Ponce de León and Antón de Alaminos
summary: The governor of Puerto Rico sails north-west to find the rumoured island of Bimini. He lands on a coast he names La Florida, and his pilot Alaminos discovers the Gulf Stream, which later carries the treasure fleets home.

stops.note: Through the islands, depopulated by slave raids.
Lands at Easter (Pascua Florida) and names the land.
A current so strong it drives the ships backwards: the Gulf Stream.
Round the keys to the west coast; fights with the Calusa.
Home. In 1521 he returns to settle and is killed by a Calusa arrow.
